step1.description:
In many ways, GraphQL has been the pinnacle of data fetching in front-end applications since its inception. Yet it seems like every year we come up with new methods to send our data to the browser. Even React Server Components are rumored to have come about as an attempt to answer this question. Let's look critically at why this question got asked in the first place, and why we are still asking it.
